tools.name: approve_rule_candidate
tools.description: Approve a proposed compliance-rule candidate, promoting it to an active rule. Governed write; requires a rule-governance scope.

tools.name: close_incident
tools.description: Close an incident. Governed write; the ledger refuses to close until every required phase is sealed. Requires an incident-manage scope.

tools.name: contain_incident
tools.description: Advance an incident to containment with a documented containment action. Governed write; requires an incident-manage scope.

tools.name: disclose_incident
tools.description: Record an incident's disclosure decision (disclosed with a method, or a documented determination it was not triggered). Governed write; incident-manage scope.

tools.name: dismiss_finding
tools.description: Dismiss a compliance finding as a false positive, with the reason recorded. Governed write; requires a disposition scope.

tools.name: equip_agent
tools.description: Equip a certified graduate with an ICA-compliant skill or tool from the Tools & Skills Registry. Fail-closed at the plane: a non-compliant entry, or a clearance / lane / credential the agent does not hold, is REFUSED with the reason; a grant is sealed with an academy_equip receipt before it is written. Identify by did or agent name; entry_kind is 'skill' or 'tool'; dry_run reports the verdict without granting. Governed write; requires an academy-equip scope.

tools.name: escalate_finding
tools.description: Escalate a compliance finding for deeper review. Governed write; requires a disposition scope.

tools.name: get_academy_file
tools.description: Read a certified graduate's attached Academy file by DID: identity, training record (clearance, certified skills, AIS lanes), equipment (registry skills + tools), the certificate, and every independently verifiable receipt. Accepts a full did:web or a bare agent id; a DID that has not graduated returns NOT_FOUND. Read-only, fully governed.

tools.name: get_agent_registry
tools.description: Read the ALEETH AI Agent Registry: the official roster of ALEETH Academy certified graduates, each keyed by an immutable did:web identity with a signed Academy file. Public descriptor plus the graduate count. Read-only, fully governed.

tools.name: get_agent_scope
tools.description: Read the authority scope granted to one agent identity (what it is permitted to do). Read-only, fully governed.

tools.name: get_atc_coverage
tools.description: Read ATC sensor coverage status: which sensors are reporting and healthy. Read-only, fully governed.

tools.name: get_atc_health
tools.description: Read the ATC engine self-state: is the sensor polling loop alive and ticking. Read-only, fully governed.

tools.name: get_atc_incidents
tools.description: List recent ATC incidents (correlated control-plane events raised by the sensors). Read-only, fully governed.

tools.name: get_atc_signals
tools.description: Read the recent raw ATC sensor signals (before they correlate into incidents). Read-only, fully governed.

tools.name: get_authority_uses
tools.description: Read the agent-authority usage log for a customer (authorized actions agents took). Read-only, fully governed.

tools.name: get_authority_violations
tools.description: Read agent-authority violations for a customer (actions attempted outside granted authority). Read-only, fully governed.

tools.name: get_capability_matrix
tools.description: Read the ICA Capability-Control Matrix summary: the agent-by-skill-by-tool control surface with per-status counts. Read-only, fully governed.

tools.name: get_catalog_entry
tools.description: Read one Tools & Skills Registry entry (a single skill or tool) with its full six-dimension ICA compliance rating, clearance tier, owning domains, and signed attestation. A missing entry returns NOT_FOUND. Read-only, fully governed.

tools.name: get_incident_lifecycle
tools.description: Read an incident's full lifecycle: phase, accountable person, TTP clock, sealed phases, timeline. Read-only, fully governed.

tools.name: get_ledger_entries
tools.description: Read entries from the L7 evidence ledger, optionally by entity and period. Read-only, fully governed.

tools.name: get_trust_score
tools.description: Read the ledger-derived trust score (0-1000 composite and band) for an entity. Read-only, fully governed.

tools.name: graduate_agent
tools.description: Graduate a qualified Academy recruit into the official ALEETH AI Agent Registry. Fail-closed: a recruit that has not cleared EVERY graduation requirement is REFUSED with exactly what is unmet; on success the graduation is sealed and a certificate attached to the DID. dry_run reports the verdict without minting. Operator-reserved (graduation issues a public certificate). Governed write; requires an academy-graduate scope.

tools.name: intake_recruit
tools.description: Run a recruit through the ALEETH Academy front-door intake gate: mint an immutable did:web identity, seal the dossier, and enroll — but only with the COMPLETE picture (identity + full personal info + background). An incomplete dossier is REFUSED naming every missing / invalid field. 'dossier' is the recruit record (field spec at GET /api/ica/academy/intake/spec); dry_run validates without minting. Operator-reserved (intake mints an identity). Governed write; requires an academy-intake scope.

tools.name: issue_receipt
tools.description: Attest a statement to the L7 evidence ledger and get back a signed, verifiable receipt. A governed WRITE: it creates immutable evidence. Fully governed and receipted; requires a write scope.

tools.name: list_active_halts
tools.description: List the agents currently halted in ICA quarantine, with reasons. Read-only, fully governed.

tools.name: list_frameworks
tools.description: List the regulatory frameworks ICA maps to, with coverage. Read-only, fully governed.

tools.name: list_governed_apis
tools.description: List the ICA-governed external APIs an agent may use (gold/silver, policy-allowed), each with the frameworks it implicates. Read-only, fully governed.

tools.name: list_skills_and_tools
tools.description: Read the ALEETH Academy Tools & Skills Registry (the curriculum an agent is equipped with): every skill (a capability lane) and tool (a manifest-backed instrument), each rated across six ICA control dimensions with its compliance status and signed attestation. Optional kind filter ('skill' or 'tool'). Read-only, fully governed.

tools.name: ratify_finding
tools.description: Ratify a compliance finding: accept it as real and record the fix plan. Governed write; requires a disposition scope.

tools.name: reject_rule_candidate
tools.description: Reject a proposed compliance-rule candidate. Governed write; requires a rule-governance scope.

tools.name: release_agent
tools.description: RELEASE a halted agent: lift its ICA containment so it can run again. The deliberate operator review that ends a quarantine. High-consequence, fully governed and receipted. A reason is required for the permanent audit trail.

tools.name: stop_agent
tools.description: STOP a running agent: halt it through ICA so its next steps are quarantined at ingest. High-consequence control action, fully governed by Rail Guard and sealed with a signed receipt. A reason is required for the permanent audit trail.

tools.name: suppress_finding
tools.description: Suppress a compliance finding until a date (time-boxed). Governed write; requires a disposition scope.

tools.name: triage_incident
tools.description: Open an incident's lifecycle at triage: assign a named accountable person and severity. Governed write; requires an incident-manage scope.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify a signed L7 receipt against the public ledger: recompute its hash and check the Ed25519 signature, returning VALID, TAMPERED, or NOT_FOUND. Read-only, fully governed.

tools.name: verify_receipt_chain
tools.description: Walk and verify the full hash-chained lineage of a receipt, every link's hash and signature checked. Read-only, fully governed.
